svg.title: Anthropic's agent memory components, by how long memory must last
svg.desc: Four layers, from shortest to longest lived. Within one task: context editing clears old tool results. When the window fills: compaction summarizes the history. Across context resets: the agent writes notes to files outside the window, such as with the memory tool. Across sessions: memory files like CLAUDE.md and auto memory load at the start of every session.
svg.text: Old tool results are swapped for a placeholder; the record of the call stays.
The lightest fix: nothing is summarized, and anything cleared can be fetched again.
Near the limit, the model summarizes the history and starts over from the summary.
Keeps decisions and open problems, drops repeated tool output. Lossy.
The agent writes progress and findings to files, and reads them back later.
Survives compaction and context resets: a to-do list, NOTES.md, /memories.
Loaded at the start of every session: rules you write (CLAUDE.md) and
lessons the agent writes for itself (auto memory).
